description: This source file defines an Android background worker class (EventReminderWorker) that schedules and sends notifications for calendar events happening the next day. It utilizes the Android WorkManager framework with CoroutineWorker, accesses a Room database repository to retrieve events, and manages notifications via NotificationManager.

classes.name: EventReminderWorker
classes.description: A Kotlin class extending CoroutineWorker to perform scheduled background tasks for fetching upcoming calendar events and showing notifications.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Suspended override function that calculates next day's time range, retrieves events from the repository, and triggers notifications for each event.
